Zero-downtime migrations, lessons from production incidents, dashboardless products, two upcoming meetups and more: Here’s what we covered in our latest Wix Engineering newsletter (October, 2026)


###


Our AI Agent’s Design Looked Complete. 3 Runtime Checks Proved It Wrong / Yoav Abrahami


Unnecessary APIs, over-engineered types, and an update flow that would leave stale data on screen. Written mostly by the agent itself (!), this account of designing for Wix’s Jay framework shows how human review caught the flaws - with four practical checks for working with AI agents.


[Read here](https://www.wix.engineering/post/our-ai-agent-s-design-looked-complete-3-runtime-checks-proved-it-wrong)


###


No Dashboard, No Menus: How We Built an Interface Around Intent / Idan Layfer


**What happens when an AI agent brings users the UI they need?**


Explore the architecture behind persistent agent-built interfaces, precise data exchange, and synchronized components - and how a merchant launched a cashback program in 10 minutes.


[Read here](https://www.wix.engineering/post/no-dashboard-no-menus-how-we-built-an-interface-around-intent)


###


Stop Reading Your New Codebase. Start Exploring It / Shahar Mayzel


**You’ve read the files. Are you ready for your first "boss fight"?**


Approach onboarding like an open-world game: trace end-to-end flows, map dependencies, and use AI as your sidekick to prepare for your first high-stakes change.


[Read here](https://www.wix.engineering/post/stop-reading-your-new-codebase-start-exploring-it)


###


Don’t Offer What Can’t Be Done: Deterministic Executability Gating for LLM Skill Selection at Scale / Ortal Ashkenazi, Vitalii Kloz & Mykhailo Ulianchenko


Matching a skill doesn’t mean a user can use it. Across 756K+ production messages, Helpmate’s executability gate filtered out 59.4% of matched skills, reduced skill context by 90.5%, and saved 228.8M tokens. Read the paper on


[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.01050v1) .


###


\[Upcoming Meetup\] Migrations at Scale: Code, Infrastructure & Automation / Dana Avital & Shmuel Mekonen


From automating changes across hundreds of codebases to migrating 1,000+ MySQL servers across 160+ clusters in 30 days with zero downtime. Explore the architecture, automation, and tradeoffs behind both migrations. Nov 11, 17:30, TLV.


[Join here](https://www.wix.engineering/migrations-at-scale)


###


\[Upcoming Meetup 2\] Data Agents Beyond the Demo / Yarden Wolf, Eden B. & Jonathan Ohana Bikel


**Your pipeline is green. Your data is wrong. Can your agent tell?**


Learn how to automate incident resolution across 8,000+ Airflow DAGs, build domain-aware agents, and catch data issues that pipeline monitoring misses. Nov 23, 17:30, TLV.


[Join here](https://www.wix.engineering/data-agents-beyond-the-demo)


###


How to Win in Production: Lessons from Real Incidents at Wix / Guy Nahum


Better on-call starts with learning from real failures. Watch Guy unpack production incidents, the patterns they exposed, and practical habits for reducing noise, learning without blame, and using AI responsibly. Watch:
